run_time_prompt_addition:
## Output

Generate exactly one image. Save it as `out.png` in the current working directory (the workspace root).
model_note: The image_gen call does not appear in the --json event stream, so the model name is not reported.
copied_into_workspace_by: gen.mjs (copied out.png out of the Codex temp dir)

screening.baked_light_or_shadow: flattest of the four: no cast shadow, no glow, only line work on the hoodie. The shade interior is painted amber (same caveat as v2_2).
screening.background_flat_and_keyable: no alpha (rgb24): magenta #FF00FF fallback after Codex discarded its own first render for halos. Flat key; a hard key leaves a 1 px pink fringe (visible in evidence/asset-style-tile/cut_parts.jpg); needs despill before use.
screening.pieces_separated: yes, 6 islands, all cut whole by cut.mjs --auto. Gaps 24-32 px (asked ~40).
screening.on_palette: yes. Navy, cream, kraft, amber, one red circle, gator green only on the gator. Closest to dry-brush gouache on card.
screening.resolution: 2048x768, the largest of the four. Gator ~361 px, desk ~283 px: closest to the spec scale.
screening.banned_ai_tells: every piece has the same thin cream torn rim (doc 03: the same procedural edge on every shape).
screening.notes: Proper desk with legs, perforated calendar top, side-view gator with a short snout and sleepy eye. 2 image_gen calls inside this one Codex run.
screening.text: none: calendar boxes blank, no logo, no letters or numbers anywhere
screening.method: Viewed full size with the Read tool, composited over #808080 and #1E2440 (evidence/asset-style-tile/contact.jpg), 3x zoom of the gator head edge, and alpha islands counted with tools/cut.mjs --auto (6 of 6 in every variant).
